simple.meaning: תַּחַן (Tachan) is a Hebrew word meaning “Tachan , the name of two Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תַּחַן (H8465) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 26:35, with occurrences in Numbers, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּחַן (H8465) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תַּחַן (H8465) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תַּחַן (Tachan) / H8465 is traced through Numbers 26:35, 1 Chronicles 7:25 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
